title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.17393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning for coding agents increasingly relies on long-running agent harnesses to manage tool integration, repository contexts, and execution feedback. However, the native execution environments of these harnesses are inherently misaligned with policy-gradient training: environmental crashes and reward hacking corrupt outcome signals, while train-inference discrepancies decouple rollout behavior from policy updates. To address this, we present LEGO-RL, a framework that bridges native coding-agent harnesses with scalable policy-gradient optimization without modifying their internal control flow. translated_title: LEGO-RL：面向编码智能体的原生强化学习框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17393v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：针对编码智能体的强化学习日益依赖于长时间运行的智能体框架来管理工具集成、仓库上下文和执行反馈。然而，这些框架的原生执行环境与策略梯度训练本质上不匹配：环境崩溃和奖励黑客行为会破坏结果信号，而训练-推理差异则导致展开行为与策略更新脱节。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LEGO-RL，一个在不修改内部控制流的情况下，将原生编码智能体框架与可扩展策略梯度优化相结合的框架。LEGO-RL基于三大支柱构建：（1）通过进程内LLM代理实现忠实优化，捕获原始生成流以进行令牌级对齐，并在框架侧压缩或重新序列化的情况下，进行稳健的训练器侧对数概率重计算；（2）通过可扩展沙箱编排实现可靠执行，该编排具备...
tldr: LEGO-RL 提出了一种新框架，在不修改原生编码智能体内部流程的情况下，通过进程内LLM代理和可扩展沙箱编排，实现了与策略梯度优化的有效对齐，解决了环境崩溃和奖励黑客行为带来的训练问题。
en_tdlr: LEGO-RL proposes a novel framework that aligns native coding-agent harnesses with scalable policy-gradient optimization via in-process LLM proxying and scalable sandbox orchestration, addressing environment crashes and reward hacking without modifying internal control flow.
